messages:
emily: Putting up a draft of the release notes for the docs site — target deploy tomorrow EOD. Can folks check SDK snippets, the migration guide checklist, and the known-issues bullets? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1102
raj: on it. I'll sanity-check the Python/TS snippets and run the TS sample locally.
marco: I can take the migration guide bullets (breaking changes + recommended fallback configs).
olivia: I'll sweep for broken links and do a shallow run of anchorcheck. Found one dead link in the embeddings page earlier.
docs-bot: PR 1102 status: CI passed (docs build). 3 unresolved TODO comments.
emily: Thanks — TODOs are: 1) clarify streaming behavior for embed endpoint, 2) update the SDK sample for new config param, 3) add known issue about quantized model tokenization quirk.
raj: quick note on the TS sample: we changed the client initializer to accept "region" and "prefetchCache". Current snippet still shows old signature. Will push a tiny PR to fix.
raj: snippet I plan to replace: ```js
import {RedwoodClient} from '@redwood/inference-sdk'
const client = new RedwoodClient({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY})
```
raj: new snippet should be: ```js
import {RedwoodClient} from '@redwood/inference-sdk'
const client = new RedwoodClient({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, region: 'us-west-2', prefetchCache: true})
```
marco: for migration guide, suggest adding a short table: breaking param -> old behavior -> new recommended config -> mitigation. I'll draft and push as a doc patch.
olivia: link sweep report: 
- /docs/embeddings/index: external link to model card 404 (need update)
- /docs/sdk/ts: anchor mismatch on "client-opts" (should be client-options)
I'll open redirects where possible.
emily: Known issues paragraph draft: "Quantized K-Formats: occasional tokenization drift observed on v1.3 quantized builds for long prefix prompts. Workaround: use the non-quantized fallback in routing policy or shorten prefix caching window." Thoughts?
jen: wording could be more action-oriented. Maybe: "Workaround: route affected requests to the non-quantized model variant or reduce prefix length. We're tracking a fix — see issue #457."
emily: good edit, I'll swap that in and link the GH issue.
marco: one more: call out that Dedicated customers may see different latency profiles for model variants - suggest a short note under "performance".
raj: PR 1103 created to patch TS snippets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1103 (small).
docs-bot: New PR 1103 opened by raj — checks queued.
emily: timeline: if PR 1103 merges today and link fixes + migration table are in, we can ship the docs release tomorrow. If anything blocks, flag here by 17:00 PT.
olivia: I'll run anchorcheck and push link fixes by noon PT.
marco: migration table + perf note pushed to branch "mg/migration-table" (PR 1104).
jen: I'll proof the known-issues wording and the release blurb after 3pm. Quick pass only.
emily: awesome, thanks all. If you hit anything that changes the release blurb, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
raj: merged 1103 — updated TS sample live in branch.
docs-bot: PR 1103 merged. Docs build queued.
olivia: anchorcheck done, opened redirects for 2 external links, pushed internal anchor fix.
emily: final checklist: 
- [x] TS SDK snippet fix (raj)
- [x] link fixes & redirects (olivia)
- [x] migration table draft (marco)
- [ ] known-issues blurb final proof (jen)
- [x] CI green on main branch (docs-bot shows latest build green)

emily: leaving a tweak to the known-issues phrasing for jen, otherwise ready. Will post the release blurb in #marketing once jen signs off.
jen: reviewed and added one minor wording tweak. Approving release blurb now.
emily: posting release in marketing channel in ~10m. Rolling to docs deploy queue. :rocket:
